title: Copy of Copy of Analytics Engineer
desc: Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines and reporting workflows. Collect, clean, transform, and organize data from multiple sources. Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting systems. Build and support datasets used for business reporting and analytics. Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations. Work with SQL queries to retrieve, transform, and analyze structured data. Identify data quality issues and implement solutions to prevent recurring errors. Automate repetitive data preparation and reporting tasks. Document data processes, workflows, and technical procedures. Collaborate with analysts and other departments to understand reporting needs. Support improvements to data organization, accessibility, and efficiency. Maintain appropriate data security and confidentiality standards. Qualifications Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical skills. Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. Experience with Excel, Google Sheets, or similar data tools. Understanding of data cleaning, transformation, and modeling concepts. Familiarity with ETL/ELT workflows and data pipeline fundamentals. Experience with BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau is an advantage. Knowledge of Python or other scripting languages is a plus. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate with a team. Previous experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or data analysis is preferred. Compensation & Benefits Competitive hourly pay. $400 sign-up bonus upon meeting eligibility requirements. Medical, dental, and vision insurance options. Paid time off (PTO). Paid holidays. Sick leave. 401(k) retirement savings plan. Company-sponsored life insurance options. Short-term and long-term disability coverage. Employee assistance program (EAP). Wellness programs and employee discounts. Paid training and onboarding. Career advancement and professional development opportunities. Flexible scheduling options, where available.
